name: Goliath
summary: Towering mountain folk who live for competition. Goliaths push themselves to be the best, keep score of everything and shrug off blows that would floor others.

age.summary: Goliaths mature like humans and rarely live past 100.

alignment.summary: Goliaths lean lawful, valuing fair play.

size.description: Goliaths stand 7 to 8 feet tall and weigh 280 to 340 pounds.

speed.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

languages.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Giant.

features.name: Natural Athlete
features.summary: You have proficiency in the Athletics skill.

features.name: Stone's Endurance
features.summary: When you take damage, you can use your reaction to roll a d12, add your CON modifier and reduce the damage by that total. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Powerful Build
features.summary: You count as one size larger when working out your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag or lift.

features.name: Mountain Born
features.summary: You have resistance to cold damage and are used to high altitude.
